_comment: The eight store screenshots, in upload order. scripts/bake_screenshots.py bakes from this file and __tests__/store-screenshots.test.js guards it, so the captions have one home. slot is the upload order: the stores show roughly the first three shots in search results. caption and sub are the pinned set in docs/store/screenshots-and-review.md; the test fails if they drift apart. Newlines in a caption are deliberate line breaks, not wrapping hints.

shots.caption: Seven steps, climbed together. Slow is the point.
Ask for a ride, shopping, cleaning or company.
See who needs a hand near you.
Up to 15 points from each person you help.
shots.sub: 7 for the trust steps. 5 for their review. 3 for your profile.

shots.caption:
Chat safely inside the app.
Phone numbers are shared
only when you both agree.
Your family can see you're safe.

Check in once a day. If you link a family member,
they are told when you go quiet.
